title: SplatLens Museum
subtitle: Watch a physics-steered model walk through its own memory. No GPU needed to look.
one_liner: Trail = tokens so far. Gold = prompt goal. Teal scars = pleasure memory. Rust = pain. Bright dots = big steering pushes.

milestones.title: B4d-q — Friendship (65 tok)
milestones.model_note: Gemma 3 4B Q4 (recorded; you only need the JSON to watch)
milestones.prompt: Explain the Physics of Friendship in one short paragraph.
milestones.blurb: Latest locked short-paragraph demo. Physics frozen (B4d). Clean-ish full budget on 4B.
worked: √-law splat damping so scars stop exploding (old F_s ~1872 story is dead).
Field wake (dist_weighted) so field force is actually alive, not zero by geometry.
Hard length budget ~65 tokens = practical clean-paragraph zone on 4B.
Light quality knobs (temp 0.88, rep 1.36, softer scar alphas) without reopening force hunt.
didnt_work: Pushing 80–90+ tokens with sample knobs alone — mid/late surface fray; not a force latch.
Logit bias alone as a fix for late collapse — slight calm, not a cure.
Assuming bigger force budgets = better prose on small models.
ongoing: 27B port retune (F_s climbs more late than 4B at same length).
Ocean deposit quality-gating so garbage doesn't crystallize.

milestones.title: Early v1 — Friendship (50 tok)
milestones.blurb: Early SplatLens recording. Useful as 'what the trail looked like before the July force fixes.' Scar deposit story was different; often few/no scars in this file.
worked: JSON session export + 3D random projection so people can watch without the model.
Idea that memory scars should show up as spatial objects, not just numbers in a log.
didnt_work: Relying on console-only telemetry — easy to give up if you don't know the flags.
Force caps / splat scaling still maturing; later runs re-learned what explodes.
No museum / one-command path for forks.
ongoing: This milestone is a museum exhibit, not the physics default. Prefer B4d-q for new demos.

how_to_add_checkpoint: Copy a logs/*.viz.json into tools/museum/demos/ (optionally subsample field_points), add an entry here, commit. Prefer ~50–100KB demos so git stays friendly.
